note: Nominotypical subspecies; the content is rewritten from Holmgren's (1913) original species-level description of the main form (printed in the original as Microcerotermes suluensis); the original is in German, measurements in mm. Type locality: Zululand, Entendweni, Mkosi, Somkele, Mtewa.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The nominotypical subspecies is the main form described by Holmgren: coloration much paler than parvus, head brown, clypeus almost yellow, wings narrow. Body length with wings 7 mm, body length without wings 5 mm, forewing length (5.5—) 6 mm and width 1.57 mm, head length 1.03 mm, pronotum width 0.64 mm. Compound eyes smaller and less projecting than in parvus; ocelli separated from the compound eyes by more than their diameter; posterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head rectangular, distinctly longer than wide, anteriorly as if truncate; mandibles rather short and stout, irregularly finely serrate; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 mostly shorter and narrower than segment 4. Body length 4—5.5 mm, head length with mandibles 1.56—2.09 mm, head width 0.65—0.85 mm, pronotum width about 0.57 mm. Within a single nest the head length of soldiers varies greatly; individuals with a thicker and relatively wider head than the main form were once separated as f. laticeps, larger individuals as f. grandis, and those with a red-yellow or red-brown head and almost straight mandibles with the apex bent inwards as f. hamatus.
